text:
Which statement about waves is correct?
A
All waves can travel through a vacuum.
B
All waves travel at the same speed.
C
Seismic S-waves can be modelled as longitudinal waves.
D
Waves transfer energy without transferring matter.

options.label: A
options.text: All waves can travel through a vacuum.

options.label: B
options.text: All waves travel at the same speed.

options.label: C
options.text: Seismic S-waves can be modelled as longitudinal waves.

options.label: D
options.text: Waves transfer energy without transferring matter.
